detail: `comvi.flattenCatalog` reaches `flattenCatalog` through a namespace import from "@comvi/vue", which no longer re-exports it — import it from "@comvi/core" and re-run
`import("@comvi/core/loader")` is read for `flattenCatalog`, which that entry no longer re-exports — take it from "@comvi/core" by hand
`flattenCatalog` is re-exported from "@comvi/svelte", which no longer publishes it — move it to its own `export { flattenCatalog } from "@comvi/core";` by hand
